newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close a touch higher in pre-Yule trade.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close a touch higher in pre-Yule trade.

text.p: 1240 GMT - Dutch bonds end slightly firmer in quiet holiday market, with few deals done by retail rather than institutional customers on Tuesday. Limited rise in prices not based on fundamentals, rather distorted in very thin volumes. Dealers see even quieter trade next Friday.
* 6.25 July 1998 unchanged at 104.16/24, bid yld 3.41 pct.
* Sept 2001 up four bp at 116.78/88, bid yld 4.69 pct.
* 10-yr yld spread vs April 2006 bund widens to -11 bp from -8.
* Jan 2023s rise to 112.51/71, 6.49 pct yield from 112.27/47.
